title_en: PhD Student · Donghua University · AI4Rad Lab
title_cn: 博士研究生 · 东华大学 · AI4Rad Lab
bio_en: PhD student (2026 cohort) at the School of Information Science and Technology, Donghua University, and a member of AI4Rad Lab. Received a Master's degree in Engineering from Shenyang University of Technology in 2023. Research focuses on medical imaging AI, CT report analysis, and point-cloud statistical shape modeling.
bio_cn: 东华大学信息科学与技术学院 2026 级博士研究生，AI4Rad Lab 成员。2023 年于沈阳工业大学获工科硕士学位，研究方向包括医学影像人工智能、CT 报告分析与点云统计形状建模。
interests_en: CT report analysis with large language models
interests_cn: 基于大语言模型的 CT 报告分析

news_en.text: Imaging-Grounded Stroke MLLM — a multi-agent multimodal LLM framework for imaging-grounded treatment recommendation in acute ischemic stroke — published in npj Digital Medicine (IF 18.0). Co-first author.
HR-LLM-Stroke — a multi-agent LLM framework for emergency stroke treatment recommendation — published in Journal of Medical Internet Research (IF 8.2).

news_cn.text: 影像驱动卒中 MLLM —— 面向急性缺血性卒中影像驱动治疗推荐的多智能体多模态大语言模型框架，发表于 npj Digital Medicine（IF 18.0）。共同第一作者。
HR-LLM-Stroke —— 面向急诊卒中治疗推荐的多智能体大语言模型框架，发表于 Journal of Medical Internet Research（IF 8.2）。
